added_comments.text: Precedence (lowest to highest): defaults, config file, APP_* env vars.

rationale: The agent removed the _PROD_OVERRIDES workaround entirely and fixed mergeLayers ordering so env vars always take precedence over the file for every key, resolving the whole class of bugs rather than adding a special case for APP_CACHE__TTL_SECONDS. The SOC2 log-level exception (deleting envLayer.logLevel in production) was preserved unchanged, and a new test explicitly confirms it still holds.
